command: W=/projects/sequence_analysis/vol3/bizon/roborobo; O="$ROBOROBO_OUT"; { echo "== git dir"; ls -la "$W/git"; echo "== checkouts"; find "$W" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name "grapenuts*" 2>/dev/null; } > "$O/found.txt" 2>&1; git init -q --bare "$O/g.git"; n=0; for r in "$W"/git/grapenuts*.git $(find "$W" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name "grapenuts*" -not -name "*.git" 2>/dev/null); do if git -C "$r" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then n=$((n+1)); echo "== fetch $r" >> "$O/found.txt"; git -C "$O/g.git" fetch -q "$r" "+refs/*:refs/src$n/*" >> "$O/found.txt" 2>&1; fi; done; echo "== has 486d8eb" >> "$O/found.txt"; git -C "$O/g.git" rev-parse --verify "486d8eb^{commit}" >> "$O/found.txt" 2>&1; git -C "$O/g.git" for-each-ref >> "$O/found.txt" 2>&1; git -C "$O/g.git" bundle create "$O/grapenuts.bundle" --all >> "$O/found.txt" 2>&1; rm -rf "$O/g.git"; cat "$O/found.txt"
